messages:
marco: quick flag 00: on keyboard nav, opening a canary detail collapses the timeline but focus lands at the top of the page. reproducer: tab to canary row -> Enter -> detail opens -> focus lost. screenshot: https://img.redwood.test/rollout-keyboard-02.png

anya: thanks for reporting. expected behavior: after open, focus should go to the panel heading and SR should announce 'Canary details: <variant>'. add role=\"dialog\" or role=\"region\" + aria-modal? prefer region so we don't trap focus.

olivia: agree with region. also we should toggle aria-expanded on the row toggle and set aria-controls to the panel id. treats it like an expander not a modal. SR announcement should be concise: \"Canary details: v3.2.4, 5% traffic\". keep aria-live=\"polite\" only when opened.

kevin: on rollback flows: landing CTA is very terse. propose changing the primary button text to: \"Rollback to previous stable\" and secondary to \"Cancel\". confirmation modal should contain: who will be affected line and an optional reason field. audited reasons get stored in the timeline metadata.

sam: slider accessibility note: current slider lacks fine-grain keyboard control. add left/right arrow step by 1, PageUp/PageDown by 10, Home/End. also add a numeric input fallback next to the slider for precise values. for trap issue, ensure Arrow keys don't trap outside and Esc blurs the slider.

anya: microcopy suggestion for timeline: when a canary is active, label should read: \"Canary: v3.2.4 3 5%\" (variant pill + percentage). avoid ambiguous labels like just \"v3.2.4\". add hover tooltip: \"Serving 5% of traffic\".

marco: small CSS: panel header contrast is fine but clickable targets inside the panel are <44px sometimes. can we ensure buttons are at least 44x44 token-compliant? touch target issue for mobile/tablet.

olivia: good catch. also request: when scrubbing history, SR should announce full context: date/time + active variants. example: \"Viewing timeline: 2025-09-02 09:12 UTC 3 showing v3.2.0 (stable), v3.2.4 (canary 10%)\".

kevin: traceability: every manual rollback or traffic-change must append a short immutable entry: who, when, change delta, and optional changelist link. expose a small chevron to expand the metadata in timeline.

design-bot: created ticket D-1250: \"Rollout expander focus + rollback CTAs + slider a11y\". https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/D-1250

olivia: action items:
- anya: implement aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-live on open (owner: anya)
- sam: slider keyboard + numeric fallback + Esc behavior (owner: sam)
- kevin: rollback button copy + confirmation modal + timeline metadata (owner: kevin)
- marco: touch target sizing + header spacing (owner: marco)
I'll add the figma link and mark D-1250 for next sprint grooming. ping me if you want to pair on VoiceOver checks.
